-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #12 / Scene #1 - Function ygdrasil1
function ygdrasil1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	HideOriginalObjs(0)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town001D.map")
	MoveCamera(677.00, 750.00, 76.00)
	RotCamera(0.85, 0.88, 48.90)


	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	OpenTalkScene(1, 1)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(ygdrasil1)
